name: How logical time keeps tweens exact

breakpoints.label: Progress drives the next signal value
breakpoints.note: The clock advances on ragged browser frames. Progress selects the next signal value; the thread retains its exact operation boundary.

breakpoints.label: Parent joins at the exact child end
breakpoints.note: The parent takes the latest child end, not the clock that noticed completion. The logical series shows that exact join target.

breakpoints.label: Replay reconstructs state with effects held
breakpoints.note: Replay simulates ten frames between samples. The clock races forward while effects are held; the final signal state matches live playback.

collectors.expr: typeof threads !== 'undefined' ? Math.max(thread.time, ...threads.map(t => t.time)) : typeof thread !== 'undefined' ? thread.time : this.runtime.root.time
typeof start !== 'undefined' && typeof seconds !== 'undefined' ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (thread.runtime.now - start) / seconds)) : null

notes: Record first, then scrub: compare the state at two samples of the same probe. The pane never controls execution.
